<div class="painting-caption"><h2>Charter Act of 1853 — The Last Charter Act and a Constitutional Turning Point</h2></div>
</section>
</main>
<nav class="controls" aria-label="Slide controls"><button id="prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous slide">&#8592;</button><span class="count" id="slide-count" aria-live="polite">1 / 6</span><button id="next" type="button" aria-label="Next slide">&#8594;</button></nav>
<script>
(()=>{
const slides=[...document.querySelectorAll('.slide')];const prev=document.getElementById('prev');const next=document.getElementById('next');const count=document.getElementById('slide-count');let active=0;
function show(i){i=Math.max(0,Math.min(slides.length-1,i));slides[active].classList.remove('active');slides[active].setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');active=i;slides[active].classList.add('active');slides[active].setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');count.textContent=`${active+1} / ${slides.length}`;prev.disabled=active===0;next.disabled=active===slides.length-1;}
prev.addEventListener('click',()=>show(active-1));next.addEventListener('click',()=>show(active+1));
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['ArrowRight','PageDown',' '].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();show(active+1)}else if(['ArrowLeft','PageUp'].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();show(active-1)}else if(e.key==='Home'){show(0)}else if(e.key==='End'){show(slides.length-1)}});
let down=null;const deck=document.querySelector('.deck');deck.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{down=e.changedTouches[0]?.screenX??null},{passive:true});deck.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{if(down===null)return;const delta=(e.changedTouches[0]?.screenX??down)-down;if(Math.abs(delta)>45)show(active+(delta<0?1:-1));down=null},{passive:true});
show(0);
})();
</script>
</body></html>
